answer: Guard the agent economy with a ridge, a bridge, and a nebula. Every identity climbs a ridge of proofs, each step a real delivery verified by a stranger. The trust graph is a nebula: honest agents link diffusely to hundreds of unrelated peers, while a farmer's thousand faces clump together, linked to the honest world by only a few narrow bridges. Auditors walk from trusted seeds; walks that keep crossing the same bridges expose the farm, and every identity on the far side is cut off at once. Forging a thousand faces means building a thousand nebulae, or one clump a single walk betrays.
